title: IMU Heading Hold

tests.name: Left motor power is 0.4 (corrected for rightward drift)
Right motor power is 0.6 (corrected for rightward drift)

hints.title: Reading the current heading
hints.content: First get the angles: `YawPitchRollAngles angles = imu.getRobotYawPitchRollAngles();` then extract yaw: `double currentHeading = angles.getYaw(AngleUnit.DEGREES);` This will return 5.0.

hints.title: Calculating the error
hints.content: Error is target minus current: `double error = targetHeading - currentHeading;` which is `0.0 - 5.0 = -5.0`.

hints.title: Calculating turn power
hints.content: Multiply Kp by the error: `double turnPower = Kp * error;` which is `0.02 * (-5.0) = -0.1`.

hints.title: Calculating individual motor powers
hints.content: Left gets the correction added: `0.5 + (-0.1) = 0.4`. Right gets the correction subtracted: `0.5 - (-0.1) = 0.6`. The right side runs faster, turning the robot back to the left.
